Package com.tonic.analysis.execution.debug

Class DebugSession

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.execution.debug.DebugSession
  • public final class DebugSession
extends Object
    Interactive stepping debugger over a BytecodeEngine, driving breakpoints, step modes, and state snapshots for listeners.
